_comment:
Location Privacy Configuration for Kyoro-HealthHub.
  This file controls how GPS and location data is stored and shared.
  Copy this file to ~/.config/kyoro/location_privacy.json and adjust as needed.
  Missing file = store nothing (safe default).
_important:
ALL COORDINATES IN THIS FILE MUST BE FICTITIOUS FOR REPO SAFETY.
  Use only example coordinates like 48.12345, 11.54321. Never use real addresses or locations.

default._comment:
Default policy applied when no specific importer/file-type rule matches.
    store: 'none' = no location data stored at all (safe default)
    store: 'region' = store only federal state/country, no coordinates
    precision: 0-5 = decimal places for latitude/longitude (0~111km, 1~11km, 2~1.1km, 3~110m, 4~11m, 5~1m)

import_skin._comment: Skin photos: default precision 2 (~1km). Override per file type if needed.

import_lab_results._comment: Lab report PDFs and screenshots: no location storage (contains embedded photos with GPS).

import_hilo_pdf._comment: Hilo PDF importer: no location storage.

import_hilo_screenshots._comment: Hilo screenshot importer: no location storage.

import_tracks._comment: Sport tracks (GPX): precision 5 (~1m) with privacy zones enabled.

import_garmin._comment: Garmin activity details: precision 5 (~1m) with privacy zones.

import_medical_motion._comment: Medical motion analysis: no location storage by default.

zones._comment: Privacy zones around sensitive locations. Points within the radius are stored at zone_precision, even if the source policy is finer.
zones._centres_comment:
Zone centres from privacy_check.patient_places and privacy_check.patient_addresses.
    Add optional coordinates per place name below. Places without coordinates are skipped with a warning.
    NO REAL COORDINATES - use example values only.

_example_home._comment: Example: home location zone centre. REPLACE with fictitious coordinates.

external_api._comment: Precision for coordinates sent to external non-LLM services (weather, pollen, air quality APIs).

llm._comment:
Location data in prompts to remote LLM providers.
    default: level applied to any caller not explicitly listed in 'allow'.
    allow: map of caller script names to their allowed level.
    Levels: 'none' (remove all), 'region' (federal state/country only), N (raster precision, e.g. 2), 'token' (location token).

allow._comment:
Add script names (without .py extension) that are allowed to receive location data.
      Example: {"analyse_travel": "region", "analyse_exposure": 2, "analyse_location_correlation": "token"}

exports._comment: Location fields in export profiles. Only profiles listed in 'allow' include location data.

allow._comment:
Add export profile names that are allowed to include location data.
      Example: {"travel_analysis": "region", "full_medical": 2}
